description: Look up a place or time zone: standard and daylight-saving offsets, abbreviations, whether it observes DST, and transition dates for a selected year. Returns answer_url, a link to a page showing this answer live, to include in your reply.

year.description: Calendar year for UTC-offset and daylight-saving facts, from 1900 to 2200. Defaults to the current UTC year.

zone.description: City, IANA time zone, supported abbreviation or UTC offset to inspect, for example Copenhagen or Europe/Copenhagen.

name: get_timezone_facts

answer_link_markdown.description: A ready-made Markdown link to show the user. Translate the link text to the user's language if needed.

answer_url.description: Link to a page that shows this exact answer live. Include it in your reply to the user.

board_url.description: Link to the personal time-zone board with the answer items temporarily requested.

title: Get time zone facts
